item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
Issued at 11:00 PM 17 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(Godod, Salug, Liloy, LeonB.Postigo, Kalawit, Labason, Baliguian, Gutalac, Siocon, Sirawai, Sibuco, Sindangan, Manukan, JoseDalman, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Siayan, Polanco, Katipunan, DipologCity, DapitanCity, Piñan, Mutia, Rizal, Sibutad, LaLibertad), #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan, Payao, Imelda, Malangas, Alicia, Talusan, Mabuhay, Olutanga), #ZamboangaCity, #Basilan, #ZamboangaDelSur(Midsalip, Sominot, RamonMagsaysay, Tambulig, SanMiguel, Guipos, Dumalinao, SanPablo, Dinas, Dimataling, Lapuyan, Margosatubig, VincenzoA.Sagun, Pitogo, Tabina), #MisamisOccidental(SapangDalaga, Baliangao, Plaridel, Calamba, LopezJaena, OroquietaCity, Aloran), #Camiguin, #MisamisOriental(Kinoguitan, Sugbongcogon, Salay, Binuangan, Talisayan, Balingoan), #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan), #LanaoDelSur(Wao, TagoloanII), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Buldon), #Bukidnon(Talakag), #LanaoDelNorte(IliganCity), #SurigaoDelNorte(SanFrancisco, SurigaoCity, Sison, TaganaAn, Malimono, Socorro, SiargaoIsland), #DinagatIslands, #SurigaoDelSur(Cortes, CityOfTandag, Tago, Bayabas, Cagwait, Marihatag, SanAgustin, CityOfBislig, Lingig), #DavaoOriental(Boston, Cateel) and #DavaoDeOro(Monkayo) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Ipil, Titay, RosellerLim, Naga, Siay, Diplahan, Buug), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Tampilisan), #ZamboangaDelSur(Bayog, Lakewood, Kumalarang, Tukuran, PagadianCity, Labangan, Aurora, Tigbao), #LanaoDelNorte(Kapatagan, Lala), #LanaoDelSur(Pualas, Ganassi, Pagayawan, Calanogas, LumbaBayabao, Butig, SultanDumalondong, Masiu, Maguing, Bumbaran), #Bukidnon(Pangantucan and Kalilangan) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
